description: This file defines the PermissionCriteria class, which extends Criteria and includes fields and getter/setter methods related to permission filtering logic, such as permission name, availability, group IDs, and availabilities.

classes.name: PermissionCriteria
classes.description: A criteria class used for filtering permissions based on name, availability status, group IDs, and availability list.

methods.name: getAvailabilities
methods.description: Returns the list of availability strings.

methods.name: setAvailabilities
methods.description: Sets the list of availability strings.

methods.name: getGroupIds
methods.description: Returns the set of group IDs.
